scope_lock.source: Luồng C: partial sales/purchase returns + refund/payment/debt ledger boundary. Audit §8.5 item 3; catalog §11/§13; handoff from livestock-cas-recovery design § Partial return contract; extend full-return cores without inventing silent livestock recovery.
in_scope: Partial sales return against COMPLETED sale: line-level qty not exceeding sold remaining returnable
Partial purchase return against COMPLETED purchase: line-level qty not exceeding received remaining returnable
No double-return of same qty across multiple return documents (returnable ledger / sum of prior return lines)
Refund / payment / debt boundary: stock return separate from cash refund; debt ADJUST proportional or explicit; PaymentVoucher for paid portion when modeled
ProductBatch / SaleLineBatch CAS per livestock-cas-recovery handoff (read version in serializable tx, updateMany + version increment)
MUST NOT auto-set healthState to HEALTHY on return; restore qty only
Tenant scope from auth; audit SALE_RETURN / PURCHASE_RETURN (or partial variants if schema allows); idempotency keys; single serializable transaction per return document
Acceptance tests: qty caps, duplicate idempotency, CAS conflict, debt boundary, tenant isolation, no auto-recovery
out_of_scope: Frontend POS/UI maps (unless separate task later)
Full re-implementation of full-return (already sales-return-core / purchase-return-core)
New RBAC permission strings beyond existing sales:edit / purchase:edit (or inventory:edit if only stock)
